description:
Twitch channel info: display name, description, partner/affiliate status, followers, images and live-stream / last-broadcast details.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), display_name (string), description (string), created_at (string, nullable), is_partner (boolean), is_affiliate (boolean), follower_count (integer, nullable), profile_image_url (string, nullable), banner_image_url (string, nullable), is_live (boolean), stream (object, nullable), last_broadcast (object, nullable).

username.description: Twitch login name or channel URL. Example: "shroud"
